title: Count the Flux, Not the Dots

scenes.tts: You count autophagosomes in a cell, and you find more. Does the cell make more of them, or destroy fewer? Think of a sink. A fuller sink could mean the tap is on harder. It could also mean the drain is blocked. Counting dots, or reading L C three two on a blot, fails on its own.
scenes.caption: You count autophagosomes in a cell, and you find more. Does the cell make more of them, or destroy fewer? Think of a sink. A fuller sink could mean the tap is on harder. It could also mean the drain is blocked. Counting dots, or reading LC3-II on a blot, fails on its own.
scenes.visual: A cell with a few double-ringed autophagosomes gains more; a sink with a tap and a drain fills, each labelled with a question mark, then the drain is blocked.
scenes.narration: You count autophagosomes in a cell, and you find more. Does the cell make more of them, or destroy fewer? Think of a sink. A fuller sink could mean the tap is on harder. It could also mean the drain is blocked. Counting dots, or reading LC3-II on a blot, fails on its own.

scenes.tts: First, the route. In macroautophagy, a cup-shaped membrane grows around a portion of cytoplasm. It closes into an autophagosome, a vesicle bounded by two membranes. Lipid-linked L C three, called L C three two, coats these membranes. The autophagosome fuses with a lysosome. The inner membrane and its contents are digested, and the copies of L C three two on the inner membrane are destroyed there.
scenes.caption: First, the route. In macroautophagy, a cup-shaped membrane grows around a portion of cytoplasm. It closes into an autophagosome, a vesicle bounded by two membranes. scenes.visual: A cup closes round cytoplasm into a double-membrane vesicle with teal dots, moves to the lysosome, fuses; the inner vesicle and its dots vanish.
scenes.narration: First, the route. In macroautophagy, a cup-shaped membrane grows around a portion of cytoplasm. It closes into an autophagosome, a vesicle bounded by two membranes. scenes.tts: Now block the drain. Bafilomycin A one blocks the V ATPase, the pump that keeps the lysosome acidic. Lysosomal degradation stops. Assume the block is complete. Then any extra L C three two it reveals would otherwise have been destroyed. So the flux is the difference. Flux equals L C three two with bafilomycin, minus L C three two without.

scenes.tts: Here is a made-up data set. Each band is normalized to actin, and the control is set to one. Control cells read one without bafilomycin, and two with it. The flux is two minus one, which is one. Starved cells read one and a half, and four and a half. Their flux is three. Starvation triples flux. More autophagosomes are made and destroyed.
scenes.caption: Here is a made-up data set. Each band is normalized to actin, and the control is set to 1. Control cells read 1.0 without bafilomycin, and 2.0 with it. The flux is 2.0 minus 1.0, which is 1.0. Starved cells read 1.5, and 4.5. Their flux is 3.0. Starvation triples flux. More autophagosomes are made and destroyed.
scenes.visual: Bar pairs for control and starved; the gap between the pair is highlighted as flux with its subtraction; an arrow marks times three.
scenes.narration: Here is a made-up data set. Each band is normalized to actin, and the control is set to 1. Control cells read 1.0 without bafilomycin, and 2.0 with it. The flux is 2.0 minus 1.0, which is 1.0. Starved cells read 1.5, and 4.5. Their flux is 3.0. Starvation triples flux. More autophagosomes are made and destroyed.

scenes.tts: Now drug D. Without bafilomycin, it has the most L C three two of all, three point zero. With bafilomycin, three point two. The flux is only zero point two, one fifth of control. Drug D blocks fusion or degradation, not induction. Read without bafilomycin, it would look like the strongest inducer.
scenes.caption: Now drug D. Without bafilomycin, it has the most LC3-II of all, 3.0. With bafilomycin, 3.2. The flux is only 0.2, one fifth of control. Drug D blocks fusion or degradation, not induction. Read without bafilomycin, it would look like the strongest inducer.
scenes.visual: A third bar pair for drug D: tallest without bafilomycin, but almost no gap; flux 0.2 against control 1.0; the without bars are boxed, showing drug D looks strongest.
scenes.narration: Now drug D. Without bafilomycin, it has the most LC3-II of all, 3.0. With bafilomycin, 3.2. The flux is only 0.2, one fifth of control. Drug D blocks fusion or degradation, not induction. Read without bafilomycin, it would look like the strongest inducer.

scenes.tts: So do not read one band by itself. A fuller sink could be the tap or the drain. Measure with and without the lysosomal inhibitor, and subtract. The difference shows how much L C three two the lysosome destroyed in that time. A single steady-state measurement cannot show that. Keep the rule: measure the flux, not just the dots.
